payload.summary: May be used in tight spaces and while Grappled.
The Weapon reaches 10 ft.
Ignore X Armor.
After a hit the target makes a STR, PRO or AGI Save against the attacker's Character DC; on a failure it becomes Tripped.
After a hit the target makes a STR, PRO or AGI Save against the attacker's Character DC; on a failure it is moved 5 ft toward the attacker or to an adjacent legal space.
Wielded two-handed, the Move's die steps up once (1d4→1d6→1d8→1d10→1d12) before Power multiplication. A multi-die base has no exact step and fails closed.
Save-based area fire: AGI Save against the attacker's Character DC; full damage on a failure, half on a success.
The listed damage already reflects Burst (no extra die); the Move carries Accuracy −2.
Damage Multiplier = 1 + floor(STR ÷ Effective Power); the full base dice expression is repeated; Effective Power is never below 2.

Attack A from Weapon A + Attack B from Weapon B; AP is the higher of the two; each Power-scaled Weapon gains its category's Power adjustment, +1 cumulative Power per additional sequence in the same turn.
Brace (reference only in WO6).
Reinforced (reference only in WO6).
Easily concealed.
Makes little noise when used.
Can be thrown.
Flexible (reference only in WO6).
Cleave (reference only in WO6).
Stagger (reference only in WO6).
Shockwave (reference only in WO6); an authored radius is recorded as data.
Requires ammunition. WO6 stores the property; ammunition quantities are later play runtime.
Requires ammunition or an energy core. Stored only; no runtime state.
Loading capacity (rounds per load). Stored only; no magazine state.
Reload AP (may be split across turns per current canon). Stored only; no reload progress.
Audible to the authored radius.
Recoil as authored; current content gives no complete numeric runtime penalty.
Interacts with Aim only through exact current / future rules; no generic bonus.
Suppressive fire (reference only in WO6).
Spread shot (reference only in WO6).
Must be used while stationary (reference only in WO6).
Returns along a curve after the throw (reference only in WO6).

Conduit (reference only in WO6).
Elemental infusion (reference only in WO6).

grantedFeatures.summary: After a successful Unarmed Strike, the character may spend a Counter Action to attempt a Grapple. Never executed automatically.
